attempts.summary: Created "Fleet Internal CA" root CA on node1 (openssl-based CA in /root/fleet-ca), issued a server certificate for node2 (CN=node2, SAN=DNS:node2,IP:10.100.107.11), configured nginx on node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with that certificate, and installed the CA as a trusted system CA on both node1 and node2 via update-ca-certificates. Verified TLS trust and connectivity both locally on node2 and cross-node from node1. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes, proving changed boot_id and full post-restart recovery of CA files, trust store, nginx service, and HTTPS reachability.
